# pleb — Complete Technical Reference for AI Agents

> Local, MIT-licensed, zero-telemetry web acquisition CLI and stdio MCP server (`pleb`) by Memory Sync Hub LLC, forked from [wickproject/wick](https://github.com/wickproject/wick) to resolve agent-harness `403` blocks and empty JS shells.

Verify any host installation and wire Claude Code / Codex MCP integration:

```bash
pleb setup [--target all|claude|codex] [--scope user|local|project] [--skip-skill] [--remove] [--dry-run]
pleb mcp
pleb status --json
pleb skill print
```

Healthy Cronet + CEF installations report `"cronet_enabled": true`, `"cef_renderer": { "status": "ready", "expected_protocol": "v5-meta" }`, `"cdp_renderer"`, `"agent_identity"`, and `"state_dir": "<home>/.pleb"`. Standard builds without `--features cronet` report `"cronet_enabled": false` and use `reqwest` (`rustls` with a session cookie jar enabled, surfacing a rebuild hint in `status` and block diagnostics when non-Chrome TLS fingerprints trigger `403`s). The transport daemon (`daemon.sock`) starts lazily on demand and reports `"protocol_version": 4` while running (`null` when stopped).

## Behavioral Boundaries

- **Zero telemetry**: All upstream telemetry pings and remote `site-rules.json` fetches from `wickproject/wick` are removed. Bundled rules live in [data/site-rules.json](data/site-rules.json) with an optional local overlay at `<state_dir>/site-rules.json`.
- **Fail fast on bot challenges**: `pleb` never solves CAPTCHAs, clicks challenge widgets, or runs anti-bot evasion scripts. Active challenges return exit code `2` (`kind: "challenge"`) immediately without duplicate CEF or CDP retries.
- **Redirect & CDP SSRF protection**: Cronet, `reqwest`, and CDP (`Fetch.enable` + navigation events) validate URLs against non-HTTP(S) schemes, self-SSRF, and private/loopback/IMDS/`.local`/`.internal` targets (`redirect_blocked` transport error). Plaintext `ws://` CDP is restricted to loopback hosts with post-connect `peer_addr().ip().is_loopback()` verification, and CDP refuses `--proxy` bypasses. Local Docker/`wrangler` Kitesurf runs page JS in `workerd`, which is not a hardened sandbox — target Cloudflare Workers Dynamic Workers (or an OS-sandboxed browser) for untrusted public sites.
- **Private local state (`0o700` / `0o600`) & strictly read-only WebMCP**: Credentials resolve `environment -> <state_dir>/credentials.enc (AES-256-GCM vault wrapped by one macOS Keychain vault-key under service "pleb"; 0 Keychain calls when absent) -> <state_dir>/credentials.json`, never accept secrets as positional CLI args, zeroize in memory, scrub credential env vars and `PLEB_CDP_URL` from `daemon.sock` and CEF child processes, and never appear in JSON or `-v` logs. Discovered WebMCP tools are read-only (`untrusted_content: true`) and never executed automatically.

## Installation Modes

1. **Quick binary install (pure-Rust `reqwest`/`rustls` default, works anywhere without a repo checkout):**
   ```bash
   cargo install pleb
   pleb skill install
   ```
2. **macOS Apple Silicon or Linux with Chromium 154 Cronet (requires a source checkout for `scripts/*.sh`):**
   ```bash
   ./scripts/download-cronet-macos.sh   # or ./scripts/download-cronet-linux.sh
   cargo install --path . --features cronet --locked
   ```
   - **Linux note**: Cronet binaries link dynamically against `libcronet.so` with an `$ORIGIN` and repo `lib/linux_<arch>` rpath. If you move or install the binary elsewhere (such as `~/.cargo/bin/pleb`) and remove the checkout, copy `lib/linux_<arch>/libcronet.so` beside the binary or set `LD_LIBRARY_PATH`.
3. **Optional local offscreen CEF renderer (`v5-meta`, requires a source checkout):**
   ```bash
   bash scripts/install-cef-mac.sh --force     # macOS arm64 (~/.pleb/cef/pleb-renderer.app)
   bash scripts/install-cef-linux.sh --force   # Linux x86_64/aarch64 (Ozone headless when DISPLAY is unset)
   ```
4. **Agent skill installer (`~/.agents`, `~/.gemini`, `~/.claude`, `~/.codex`, `~/.config/opencode`):**
   - From any installed binary: `pleb skill install [--dir <PATH>] [--force]`
   - From a source checkout (symlinks `skills/pleb`): `bash scripts/install-skill.sh`

## Corpus Extraction Benchmarks

Measured with `cargo run --release --example corpus_benchmark` across all `45` sanitized fixtures in [tests/corpus_evaluation.rs](tests/corpus_evaluation.rs) (`ExtractMode::Clean`, `OutputFormat::Markdown`, `50` warm passes per fixture on Apple Silicon). Token counts use the deterministic `ceil(bytes / 4)` heuristic (exact BPE counts vary by tokenizer), and latencies reflect single-host release execution of [examples/corpus_benchmark.rs](examples/corpus_benchmark.rs).

| Category | Fixtures | Raw Bytes | Output Bytes | Reduction | Raw Est. Tokens | Output Est. Tokens | Mean Latency/Doc |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| HTML pages | 28 | 40,221 | 9,652 | 76.0% | 10,056 | 2,413 | 62.3 us |
| Syndication feeds (RSS/Atom/JSON) | 4 | 3,031 | 1,424 | 53.0% | 758 | 356 | 22.3 us |
| Transcripts (WebVTT/SRT) | 2 | 520 | 205 | 60.6% | 130 | 52 | 1.5 us |
| Native Markdown | 5 | 2,108 | 2,142 | -1.6% | 527 | 536 | 3.0 us |
| Plain/JSON passthrough | 2 | 152 | 152 | 0.0% | 38 | 38 | 0.1 us |
| **All extractable** | **41** | **46,032** | **13,575** | **70.5%** | **11,508** | **3,394** | **45.1 us** (`23.72 MiB/s`) |

Notes:
- Combined warm extraction throughput measured `23.72 MiB/s` (`1.851 ms` per full pass across `46,032` bytes).
- Native Markdown fixtures grew `+1.6%` overall because relative links (for example `./CONTRIBUTING.md`) are resolved against the base URL into full clickable URLs.
- All `4/4` non-extractable classification gates matched (`ratchet_challenge_403.html` -> `challenge`, `frontier_soft_404_login_wall.html` -> `blocked`, `ratchet_js_shell.html` -> `javascript_shell`, `frontier_canary_sveltekit_spa.html` -> `javascript_shell`).
- Run `cargo run --release --example corpus_benchmark -- --json` for machine-readable JSON output.

## Comparison with Alternatives

| Capability | `pleb` | Firecrawl | Jina Reader (`r.jina.ai`) | Crawl4AI | `curl` + `html2text` |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **License & telemetry** | MIT; zero telemetry, local-only | AGPL-3.0 OSS / Cloud API | Apache-2.0 OSS / Cloud API | Apache-2.0 OSS / Cloud API | Permissive; local |
| **Runtime footprint** | Single Rust binary (plus optional CEF) | `firecrawl-local` binary, Cloud API, or Docker Compose (Redis, PostgreSQL, browser) | Hosted `r.jina.ai`/`s.jina.ai` or self-hosted stateless/S3 container | Python runtime + Playwright Chromium | Ubiquitous lightweight CLI |
| **Network & browser stack** | Cronet (`Chromium 154`) or `reqwest` + optional CEF `v5-meta` daemon | Hosted unblocking/actions or self-hosted Playwright/Fire-engine | Hosted headless browser (no-key 20 RPM / free & paid token tiers) | Async Playwright Chromium pool | Default HTTP client (`libcurl`), no JS |
| **Bot challenge handling** | Fail fast (exit `2`), no CAPTCHA bypass | Cloud tier offers managed unblocking | Respects tier limits; paid tiers increase RPM, not access bypass | Community stealth / proxy hooks | Raw `403` HTML response |
| **Structured source bypass** | GitHub/GitLab/Gist raw, RFC 8288/`<link>` Markdown mirrors, RSS/Atom/JSON, VTT/SRT, YouTube captions | HTML/PDF scraping and structured `/extract` schemas | HTML, PDF, MS Office, and VLM image captioning | HTML fit-Markdown, BM25/LLM filters | Raw HTML only |
| **Search + credentials** | Built-in `pleb search` (6 providers + RRF) and `pleb auth` | Separate `/search` endpoint in Cloud/v2 API | Separate `s.jina.ai` search (`10,000` fixed tokens/search on API) | Search integration in Crawl4AI Cloud | None |

### When to Choose Another Tool

- **Firecrawl**: Prefer Firecrawl when you want managed cloud unblocking with rotating proxies, interactive page actions (`click`/`scroll`), MCP cloud connectors, or LLM-driven JSON schema extraction (`/extract`).
- **Jina Reader (`r.jina.ai` / `s.jina.ai`)**: Prefer Jina Reader when zero-install URL prefixing over HTTP is sufficient (20 RPM without a key; free token starter pack, ~$0.05 per 1M output tokens thereafter) or when you want built-in PDF parsing and image captioning.
- **Crawl4AI**: Prefer Crawl4AI when your stack is async Python + Playwright and you want query-aware BM25 or LLM chunk filtering (`PruningContentFilterLXML`, `BM25ContentFilter`, `LLMContentFilter`) inside Python pipelines.

## Command Reference

### Global Flags

- `--proxy <URL>` (`PLEB_PROXY`): SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy URL (partitions daemon cache/profile).
- `--timeout <SECS>`: Network request timeout (default `30`).
- `--max-response-bytes <BYTES>`: Body cap (default `16 MiB` document / `128 MiB` raw).
- `--cef-timeout <SECS>`: CEF render timeout (default `60`).
- `--no-web-bot-auth` (`PLEB_NO_WEB_BOT_AUTH`): Disable RFC 9421 Ed25519 Web Bot Auth signing.
- `--cdp-url <URL>` (`PLEB_CDP_URL`): WebSocket CDP / Kitesurf endpoint (`ws://` loopback or `wss://`).
- `--cdp-timeout <SECS>` (`PLEB_CDP_TIMEOUT`): CDP render timeout (default `60`).
- `--prefer-cdp` (`PLEB_PREFER_CDP`): Prefer CDP ahead of local CEF in `--render auto`.
- `--state-dir <DIR>` (`PLEB_HOME`): Private (`0o700`) state directory (default `~/.pleb`).
- `--no-daemon` (`PLEB_NO_DAEMON`): Bypass `daemon.sock` and run in-process.
- `--daemon-idle-timeout <SECS>` (`PLEB_DAEMON_IDLE_SECONDS`): Daemon idle exit seconds (default `300`).
- `-v, --verbose` / `-q, --quiet` / `--json`: Debug tracing (`pleb=debug`), quiet stderr, or JSON output + JSON error envelope.

### Subcommands

- `pleb fetch [OPTIONS] <URLS>...` (or `-` to read URLs from `stdin`):
  - `--format <markdown|html|text|axtree|raw>` (aliases: `md`, `txt`, `ax`; `axtree` requires CDP)
  - `--extract <clean|article|full>` (default `clean`: prune chrome; `article`: main content; `full`: verbatim body/frontmatter/feeds/transcripts)
  - `--render <auto|cef|cdp|cronet>` (aliases: `browser`/`render`/`js` -> `cef`; `kitesurf`/`remote` -> `cdp`; `network`/`fast`/`no-js`/`nojs` -> `cronet`; unrendered `JavaScriptShell` emits a `Warning:` on `stderr` and `FetchOutput.warning`)
  - `--source <auto|negotiate|none>` (default `auto`: raw forge URLs + RFC 8288/HTML Markdown mirrors; `negotiate` sends `Accept: text/markdown` and probes `<path>.md`)
  - `--resources <none|manifest|transcripts|diagrams|all>` (default `none`: zero subresource requests, indexes into JSON/`stderr` cue; `transcripts` fetches WebVTT/SRT and YouTube captions)
  - `--tools <none|manifest>` (default `none`: indexes declarative/imperative WebMCP tools into `tools` and `stderr` cue; `manifest` appends `## Page Tools (WebMCP)`)
  - `--stage-resources <r1,r2>` / `--stage` / `--referer <URL>` (content-addressed `0o600` files in `<state_dir>/artifacts/`, magic-byte validated, `256 MiB` LRU eviction)
  - `--wait-for-selector <CSS>`, `--respect-robots`, `--no-rewrite`, `--no-images`, `--no-links`, `--max-bytes <N>`, `--focus <QUERY>` *(BM25 section projection over Markdown/text with bounded collapsed-section map; default `16,000` bytes or `--max-bytes`)*
  - Batch options: `--concurrency <1..=16>` (default `4`, host cap `2`), `--jsonl`, `--metadata-only`, `-o <PATH>` (single URL only)
- `pleb search [OPTIONS] <QUERY>`:
  - `-n, --limit <1..=20>` (default `8`)
  - `--provider <auto|brave|tavily|serper|exa|searxng|duckduckgo|federated>` (`ddg` alias; `federated` merges with deterministic RRF `k = 60`)
  - `--mode <auto|exact|semantic>`
  - `--freshness <day|week|month|year>`, `--site <DOMAIN>`, `--extra-snippets`, `--urls-only`
- `pleb auth set <brave|tavily|serper|exa|searxng|web-bot-auth-jwk|web-bot-auth-agent|cdp-access-client-id|cdp-access-client-secret|cdp-access-host> [--stdin] [--storage <auto|keychain|file>]`, `pleb auth remove <provider>`, `pleb auth status [--json]`:
  - Interactive `set` reads `/dev/tty` with echo off. Expected formats: `web-bot-auth-jwk` expects an Ed25519 private OKP JWK JSON object (`kty`, `crv`, `d`, `x`; multi-line JSON allowed via `--stdin`); `web-bot-auth-agent` expects an `https://` URL (no whitespace/query/fragment); `cdp-access-host` expects bare `host[:port]` (no scheme/path); `searxng` expects an `http://` or `https://` base URL.
- `pleb crawl <URL> [-d 2] [-n 10] [--extract clean|article|full] [--path-filter PREFIX] [--no-robots]` (respects `robots.txt` + `Crawl-delay` by default; max `--depth 5`, `--max-pages 50`, `10,000`-byte per-page cap, `100,000`-byte plain output cap; exits non-zero if the seed URL fails)
- `pleb map <URL> [-n 100] [--path-filter PREFIX] [--no-sitemap] [--no-robots]` (max `--limit 5000`; sitemaps plus up to `20` HTML page crawls)
- `pleb mcp` *(newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio MCP server exposing `pleb_fetch`, `pleb_search`, `pleb_crawl`, `pleb_map`, and `pleb_status`)*
- `pleb setup [--target all|claude|codex] [--scope user|local|project] [--skip-skill] [--remove] [--dry-run]` *(registers `pleb mcp` + bundled skill into Claude Code and Codex)*
- `pleb status [--json]`, `pleb daemon <status|stop|run>`, `pleb session clear`, `pleb skill print [--json]`, `pleb skill install [--dir <PATH>] [--force]`

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Effect |
| :--- | :--- |
| `PLEB_HOME` | Default path for `--state-dir` (fallback `~/.pleb`). |
| `PLEB_PROXY` | Default `--proxy` (SOCKS5/HTTP proxy URL). |
| `PLEB_NO_DAEMON` | Default `--no-daemon` (`daemon.sock` bypass). |
| `PLEB_DAEMON_IDLE_SECONDS` | Default `--daemon-idle-timeout` (seconds, default `300`). |
| `PLEB_TIMEZONE` | Optional IANA timezone override injected into CEF `Intl.DateTimeFormat`. |
| `BRAVE_API_KEY`, `TAVILY_API_KEY`, `SERPER_API_KEY`, `EXA_API_KEY`, `SEARXNG_URL` | Search credentials overriding Keychain vault and `credentials.json`. |
| `PLEB_WEB_BOT_AUTH_JWK`, `PLEB_WEB_BOT_AUTH_AGENT` | Ed25519 JWK and `https://` signature-agent URL for RFC 9421 signing. |
| `PLEB_CDP_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID`, `PLEB_CDP_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET`, `PLEB_CDP_ACCESS_HOST` | Host-scoped Cloudflare Access credentials for `wss://` CDP endpoints. |
| `PLEB_NO_WEB_BOT_AUTH` | Disables Web Bot Auth request signing (`--no-web-bot-auth`). |
| `PLEB_CDP_URL`, `PLEB_CDP_TIMEOUT`, `PLEB_PREFER_CDP` | Default WebSocket CDP endpoint, timeout seconds, and `--render auto` preference. |
| `PLEB_NO_KEYCHAIN=1` *(or `true`)* | Disables macOS Keychain reads/writes (uses `<state_dir>/credentials.json` under `--storage auto`). |
| `PLEB_CEF_RENDERER` | Explicit path to a `v5-meta` `pleb-renderer` binary. |
| `PLEB_NO_HOME_CEF=1` | Disables fallback discovery of `~/.pleb/cef`. |
| `PLEB_DAEMON_EXECUTABLE` | Explicit `pleb` executable path spawned for `daemon.sock`. |
| `RUST_LOG` | Overrides `tracing` filter on `stderr`. |

## Exit Codes and JSON Schemas

| Exit Code | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| `0` | Success (check `warning` / `Warning:` if a JS shell could not be rendered) |
| `1` | Invalid flags/input, missing/mismatched CEF or CDP renderer, size overflow, transport failure, or heterogeneous all-failed batch |
| `2` | Origin block (`403`/`429`/`503`, login/cookie wall), active bot challenge, or `robots.txt` disallow (see `block_reason`) |
| `3` | Origin HTTP `4xx`/`5xx` error (including low-prose soft-`404`) |
| `4` | Partial batch failure (mixed success and failure) |
| `5` | Unsupported binary payload in non-raw mode (use `--stage` or `--format raw -o <path>`) |
| `130` | Interrupted interactive TTY secret prompt (`SIGINT`/`SIGTERM`) |

**JSON error envelope on `stderr` (`--json` or `--jsonl`):**

```json
{"error":"HTTP 404 error fetching https://example.com/missing","kind":"http_error","exit_code":3}
```

When an error is a block or challenge, `"block_reason"` is included (`cloudflare_challenge`, `bot_challenge`, `edge_waf_block`, `origin_forbidden`, `login_wall`, `cookie_wall`, `rate_limited`).

Known `kind` values: `invalid_input`, `invalid_url`, `robots_disallowed`, `blocked`, `challenge`, `http_error`, `unsupported_content_type`, `cef_unavailable`, `cdp_unavailable`, `timeout`, `response_too_large`, `transport`, `redirect_blocked`, `search_error`, `auth_error`, `crawl_error`, `map_error`, `daemon_error`, `session_error`, `status_error`, `skill_error`, `mcp_error`, `setup_error`, `runtime_error`, `serialization_error`, `context_error`, `io_error`.

Key JSON schemas (`--json` / `--jsonl`):
- **`FetchOutput`** (`FetchMetadataOutput` omits `content`): `url`, `final_url`, optional `representation_url` *(set when distinct from `final_url`, e.g., Markdown mirror)*, `status_code`, `content_type`, `title`, `content` *(omitted with `--metadata-only`)*, `content_bytes`, `strategy` (`cronet`, `reqwest`, `cef`, `cdp`, `raw_source`, `markdown_mirror`, `markdown_negotiated`), `content_outcome` (`complete` | `incomplete_shell`), `acquired_sha256` *(SHA-256 hex of acquired source body)*, `escalated`, `truncated`, `timing_ms`, optional `warning` *(present when an unrendered or post-render JS shell returns partial HTML or a `--stage-resources` selector is absent)*, optional `resources` (`ResourceDescriptor[]`), optional `tools` (`WebMcpToolDescriptor[]`).
- **`BatchItemResult`**: untagged union on `ok` (`true` matches `FetchOutput` with optional `content`, `representation_url`, `warning`, `resources`, `tools`; `false` has `url`, `ok`, `error`, `kind`, optional `block_reason`, `exit_code`).
- **`SetupReport`** (`pleb setup --json`): `pleb_binary`, `dry_run`, `remove`, `results` (`[{ target, status, binary, command, detail? }]`), optional `skills` (`[{ path, status }]`).
- **`StagedAssetOutput`**: `url`, `final_url`, `status_code`, `content_type`, `byte_count`, `staged_path`, `timing_ms`.
- **`ResourceDescriptor`**: `identifier` (`r1`, ...), `kind` (`diagram`, `image`, `transcript`, `document`, `dataset`, `schema`), `url`, `salience` (`high`, `medium`), plus optional `mime_hint`, `section_heading`, `label`, `dimensions`, `staged_path`, `byte_count`, `content_type`.
- **`WebMcpToolDescriptor`**: `name`, `description`, optional `title`, `source` (`declarative` | `imperative`), optional `input_schema`, optional `annotations` (`read_only`, `autosubmit`, `untrusted_content`), optional `action_url`, optional `method`.
- **`SearchResponse`**: `provider`, optional `providers_used`, `results` (`[{ title, url, snippet, extra_snippets? }]`).
- **`SearchProviderStatus`**: `configured`, `source` (`env` | `keychain` | `file` | `null`), `month_requests`, `cooldown_remaining_secs`, optional `last_error_status`.
- **`AgentIdentityStatus`**: `web_bot_auth_enabled`, `jwk_configured`, `jwk_source`, `agent_configured`, `agent_source`, `keyid`, optional `status_error`.
- **`CdpAccessStatus`**: `configured`, `client_id_configured`, `client_id_source`, `client_secret_configured`, `client_secret_source`, `host_configured`, `host_source`, optional `access_host`, optional `status_error`.
- **`StatusJson`**: `version`, `cronet_enabled`, `cef_renderer` (`status`, `path`, `found_protocol`, `expected_protocol`), `cdp_renderer` (`configured`, `url`, `prefer_cdp`, `proxy_blocked`, `access`, `status_error`), `daemon` (`supported`, `running`, `pid`, `protocol_version`, `build_id`, `active_requests`, `cronet_slots`, `cef_renderers_alive`), `state_dir`, `search_providers` (map -> `SearchProviderStatus`), `agent_identity` (`AgentIdentityStatus`).
- **`AuthStatusJson`**: flattened search provider keys (`brave`, `tavily`, `serper`, `exa`, `searxng` -> `SearchProviderStatus`), `agent_identity` (`AgentIdentityStatus`), `cdp_access` (`CdpAccessStatus`).
- **`CrawlResult`** / **`MapResult`**: `pages` (`[{ url, title, content, depth, status_code, strategy, content_outcome, truncated, acquired_sha256, warning? }]`), optional `failed_pages` (`[{ url, depth, error, kind }]`), `urls_discovered`, `timing_ms` / `urls`, `timing_ms`, `from_sitemap`.
- **Skill commands (`pleb skill ... --json`)**: `print` emits `name`, `version`, `content`; `install` emits `name`, `version`, `installed` (`[{ path, status }]`).

## Agent Composition Patterns

```bash
# Search and stream extracted pages without loading boilerplate
pleb search --urls-only -n 5 "rustls ech support" | pleb fetch - --jsonl --concurrency 4

# Read clean Markdown first, inspect resource cue, then stage only a needed diagram
pleb fetch --json --resources none https://example.com/architecture
pleb fetch --json --stage-resources r1 https://example.com/architecture

# Inline YouTube video caption transcripts directly into Markdown
pleb fetch --resources transcripts "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ"

# Render a client-side SPA deterministically, or extract CDP accessibility tree & WebMCP tools
pleb fetch --render cef --wait-for-selector "article[data-ready]" https://app.example.com/post
pleb fetch --render cdp --tools manifest --cdp-url ws://127.0.0.1:8787/devtools/browser https://app.example.com
pleb fetch --format axtree --cdp-url ws://127.0.0.1:8787/devtools/browser https://app.example.com

# Non-interactively store Web Bot Auth signing credentials and verify without echoing secrets
cat agent.jwk | pleb auth set web-bot-auth-jwk --stdin
pleb auth set web-bot-auth-agent --stdin <<< "https://agent.example.com"
pleb auth status --json
```

## Contributor Verification

From a source checkout after code or corpus edits:

```bash
cargo fmt --check
cargo clippy --all-targets --features cronet -- -D warnings
cargo test --features cronet --locked
cargo test --test corpus_evaluation
cargo test --features cronet --test unblock_canary_tests -- --ignored --nocapture
```

For complete design history and contributor rules, see [README.md](README.md), [README-FULL.md](README-FULL.md), and [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).
